quest.title: Kaeya's Troubles
quest.description: You bump into Kaeya, whom you first met during Stormterror's attack, at the Knights of Favonius Headquarters.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Mora x3225, Wanderer's Advice x8, Fine Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: This is bad... Such a hassle... What am I going to do...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: #Oh, thank the Thousand Winds! {NICKNAME}, your arrival must be the grace of the gods!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: If I may ask — envoy sent by the Anemo God to save this mere mortal — could you spare a moment?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ewwww, cut it out!

choices.text: Can't say I don't have time...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Marvelous!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I cannot let my peers hear about this! I cannot seek help from anyone else but you.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Please, let us move to somewhere more fit for such conversations...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Let's talk in the courtyard just outside headquarters. Come with me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's with the sneakiness...

choices.text: You don't usually lose your chill.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Help... Help!

talks.objective: Talk to Kaeya at the meeting spot

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: This place will do.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tell us what it's about already!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: How should I begin... Oh, right, let me tell you a secret first.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: It's a secret of my past, and I confide in you to keep it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Paimon's lips are sealed.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: As a matter of fact, my grandfather was a pirate!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: ...Wait, why do you sound so blithe? Do you think I'm making it up?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Look at my eye patch! I inherited it from my grandfather and this is solid proof that we are related by blood!

choices.text: I never knew you could inherit eye patches.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: #My! {NICKNAME}, how could you not know such common knowledge!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: This is no different from children inheriting their hairstyles from their parents!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Yesterday I was glancing through the notes my grandfather left and stumbled upon records that spoke of a <color=#00E1FFFF>treasure</color>...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Treasure!?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: According to his notes, the treasure is buried in the "Lost Arcadian Ruins."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Treasure...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: But the location of the ruins is currently unknown. I've tried searching for clues...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Treasure!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kaeya! What kind of treasure is it? Gold? Or better yet, gems!?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Hmph! Treasures that consist of nothing but gold and gems are third-rate treasures...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: My grandfather's treasure is a sword!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: A magic sword that grants the wielder unrivaled power!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh wowwwww!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: The sword was dropped from Celestia into the sea by a god. It was later salvaged by my grandfather's crew by pure coincidence.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: The moment he gripped the sword, thunder roared, billows howled, and the clear skies were suddenly swallowed by raging winds...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: With the might of the magic sword, my grandfather went on to defeat a hydra, a silver-haired banshee, a wicked abyss dragon...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: But the immense power of the sword enticed many more greedy pirates.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: To avoid meaningless conflicts, my grandfather hid the magic sword.

choices.text: Eight-headed hydras, silver-haired banshees... Do they really exist?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: The world we live in is fascinating, full of unknown and inexplicable wonders.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: These incredibly thrilling adventures are romances that could only be told by pirates.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Holy moley! That's just insane!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: A gang of <color=#00E1FFFF>Treasure Hoarders</color> has been very active lately and many ruins have had their relics stolen by them.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I'm afraid that they will soon discover the Arcadian Ruins and the magic sword will be lost...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We won't let it fall into the wrong hands! We must get the sword before them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #You just rest assured that Paimon and {NICKNAME} are here to help!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Wow~

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Great! Please keep it a secret. I'll wait for your good news!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hey! So whatcha think, {NICKNAME}? Isn't it exciting? We're talking about a super-duper powerful sword!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... let's go to the <color=#00E1FFFF>Adventurers' Guild</color> and see if we can find out more.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The adventurers should know more about the ruins, right?

talks.objective: Go to the Adventurers' Guild and listen to their report

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph! We're not here for something that boring!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're looking for a sword that fell from Celestia... One that can kill eight-headed banshees and silver-haired hydras.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's super, mega, uber powerful!

choices.text: It's eight-headed hydras and silver-haired banshees...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's what Paimon said! It's a super epic sword!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, it's fine as long as Paimon doesn't tell them the treasure's location!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Now she's done it...)

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Arcadian Ruins... Never heard of them.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Thanks for your intel anyway. If you do find these ruins, I'd love to see them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... my... intel...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's fine! As long as Paimon doesn't tell them the treasure's location!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, Cyrus, do you know where the Lost Arcadian Ruins are supposed to be?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No. We're here for...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nope. We just want to know if you've been to the Arcadian Ruins?

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Arcadian Ruins? Imagine that... So there are places that I haven't been to...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? Even the great Stanley doesn't know?

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Never mind this Arcadia... You need to know what happened to me on the Mare Jivari and in the Geyser Realm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We don't have time for your stories. Think hard, please. We need clues.

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: The Mare Jivari... It was a place of death...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gosh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: When we find the Arcadian<color=#00E1FFFF>treasure</color>, our story will definitely be better than your stupid stories!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Now she's done it...)

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Treasure...? Even Tales too?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph! It's a waste of time talking to him. Let's go already.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to ask...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Do you have any intel on the Arcadian Ruins?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Arcadian... Can't say I've heard of it. Sorry, I'm still new here, so...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: But you can try posting a commission and see if there are any adventurers who know about it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's a no-no! No way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We can't afford them beating us to the treasure!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Now she's done it...)

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Really!?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Well then, I'll keep a lookout for your treasure — I mean, your Arcadian Ruins.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! Thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Oh, you're back. Do you have news for me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Listen, we asked around the Adventurers' Guild and found... Well, nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Haha... That much is expected.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why is that?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Oh, I only mean that, what's the fun in finding it without the hard work?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: However, I do have some clues.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: I sent someone to collate black market intel. It seems that someone does know about the Arcadian Ruins.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Where's the guy?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Now, now, as per the black market's rules, they will send someone to meet us to prevent leaks.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: We will be meeting the informant at the Whispering Woods.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then, what are we waiting here for?

choices.text: It's not ideal for Kaeya to show his face.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: That's right. You read my mind.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I am a knight... so I shouldn't have any dealings with the black market.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: You have my thanks.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Of course, you'll be compensated for your troubles... by the Knights.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, no problemo!

choices.text: We'll get the intel back to you.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: I'm a bit busy right now. Do try to find more... clues... You know what I mean.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Arcadian Ruins

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: I am interested in your search, but I just don't have any intel for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Arcadian Ruins

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: If you are not here for my stories, we have nothing to talk about.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Arcadian Ruins

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Should I go look for it as well...? Oh, haha! I'm just joking. I hope you guys find it!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Hey, kiddo! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild!

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: I'm Stanley. Remember my name. You're also here for my stories, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Hey! Are you a new adventurer? Wanna join my adventure team?
